meta.matching: libass: byte-wise case-sensitive prefix match (mystrcmp, libass/ass_parse.c:68-78) through a first-match if/else chain (ass_parse.c:355-916); parenthesized args are split before name matching (ass_parse.c:310-349); an unmatched name is skipped to the next tag, the block survives (ass_parse.c:286-299, fallthrough at 917). xy-VSFilter: longest registered prefix (1..5 chars) of an exact-match case-sensitive map (src/subtitles/RTS.cpp:2155-2163, map 1716-1769); unknown tags count unrecognized but the block still applies its other tags (RTS.cpp:2229-2236, return(true) at 2749). VSFilterMod: two sequential chains — a prefix-normalization chain of Find()==0 tests (RTS.cpp:2524-2669) then an exact == apply chain (2677-3716+); both case-sensitive; unknown tags are silently skipped (2668-2669, return(true) at 3740).

matrix.tag: \blend is VSFilterMod-only (vpatch v003) as a distinct command. The pinned normalization chain checks "be" before "blend", but "blend" starts with "bl", not "be", so it reaches the blend branch at 2551 and the apply branch at 3716. Traditional renderers instead match its "b" prefix and consume "lend" as the remaining bare argument.

\frs is VSFilterMod-only (patch m007, apply at 3108-3115 read). In libass the frs name is matched as \fr with remainder "s" (prefix tag() at ass_parse.c:547, mystrcmp byte prefix 68-78) — the arg is non-numeric so the value becomes 0, silently rotating the Z angle away.

matrix.taggroup: Absent from libass and xy-VSFilter entirely (ASS005). In VSFilterMod each has a normalization prefix test and an exact apply branch; lua is compiled in only under _LUA (RTS.cpp:2464-2471). Several normalization branches are comment-disabled no-ops (1img 2529-2530, 1vc/1va 2533-2536), leaving those names to fall through to unknown. blend, frs and fsvp are covered by individual rows above; per-tag params for this set are Phase 2 work.
